name: Distributed Volume Ray Tracing with Global Kd-Tree
aliases: Ma and Crockett Distributed Cell Projection
definition: A distributed rendering method for load balancing where adjacent tetrahedra are scattered across nodes rather than clustered, using a global kd-tree to restore ordering during rendering.
summary: Distributed Volume Ray Tracing with Global Kd-Tree scatters adjacent tetrahedra across nodes for load balancing in close views, using a global kd-tree to restore spatial ordering.
